msc_ownership_reason: The central new assertion is a full integral homotopy equivalence using Hurewicz and homological Whitehead, rather than a face-enumeration or representation result; primary 55P15.
scientific_integrity: The homotopy proof uses Caputi–Collari–Smith Theorems 2.8 and 2.10 as published connectivity/integral-homology premises. Embedded-sphere generators and small-polygon gluing are proved separately. The finite mod-two checker corroborates rather than establishes the infinite theorem. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary multipath complexes of bidirected simple cycles are classified.
The bidirected triangle is disconnected (two circles), not one based wedge.
The uniform lower-sphere maps are existential through Hurewicz; no natural equivariant homotopy splitting is claimed.
The integral homology and connectivity inputs are cited published theorems rather than independently reconstructed.
title: Complete homotopy classification of bidirected-cycle multipath complexes
